review.en: A nanomaterials scientist is drawn into a strange online game and a decades-old secret involving a distant star system. The first volume of Liu Cixin's trilogy is hard science fiction of enormous scale, building its wonders out of real physics. The prose and characters are workmanlike; the ideas are thrilling. Ken Liu's translation won the Hugo Award in 2015.
review.zh: 纳米材料科学家汪淼被卷入一款奇怪的网络游戏，以及一个牵涉遥远星系、隐藏了几十年的秘密。刘慈欣三部曲的第一部，是格局宏大的硬科幻，奇观都建立在真实的物理之上。文字和人物较平实，构想却令人兴奋。英译本 2015 年获雨果奖。
